summary: Phase 1 discovery testing: 28 pytest cases against /api/discover + /api/discover/facets + admin program tag PATCH + regressions (27 pass, 1 fail = data gap). Frontend Playwright: /discover (load, type tabs, filter panel, focus/duration chips, clear-all, search, card nav, mobile 390px), homepage Discover CTA + 5 coming-soon teasers, admin course tag editor (focus chips + intensity + language) with reload persistence and /api/discover reflection, plus /programs/:id and /asanas regression. All UI flows passed with zero console errors. Auth playbook spot-check: bcrypt $2b$ hash, HttpOnly+Secure+SameSite=None cookie on login, admin role intact.

minor.issue: Seed backfill never assigns 'Energy' (seed.py _focus() has no rule for it) -> facet chip returns 0 results / empty state. 'Balance', 'Stress relief', 'Sleep' have only 1 item each while 'Flexibility' has 68/72, so the taxonomy barely discriminates. Counts: Back care 6, Flexibility 68, Balance 1, Strength 42, Stress relief 1, Sleep 1, Energy 0, Beginner basics 27.
All 72 items are backfilled language='both', so both language chips return the identical full 72 results — the Language filter is a no-op for users.

No server-side validation of the new tag fields: intensity='nuclear' and focus_areas=['Not A Focus'] are accepted with 200 and persisted, which would pollute Discover filtering. Unauthenticated PATCH correctly returns 401.

issues: Page copy is English-only even with ES locale active (known Phase-1 follow-up)
Selecting the 'Energy' focus chip always shows the 'Nothing matches those filters yet' empty state — dead-end filter caused by the backfill gap
Language chips (English/Español) never change the result count (72 -> 72)
'Meditations — Coming soon' teaser conflicts with the existing 'Meditation' style class already published in the library/Discover facets
YouTube embed for lesson bcde4f96-2f2e-4c3f-8a28-9f1eec93f4c9 renders 'Video unavailable' — pre-existing seed/video-id issue, not related to Phase 1

action_items: Extend seed.py _focus() so 'Energy' (and more balanced Balance/Sleep/Stress relief) tags are assigned; today the Energy chip is a guaranteed empty state.
Either give some content language='en'/'es' or hide the Language filter until multilingual content exists — currently both chips return all 72 items.
Validate intensity (enum gentle/moderate/strong) and focus_areas (must be in FOCUS_AREAS) in the admin program PATCH payload.
Optional: hide/disable Discover facet chips that would yield 0 results, or show counts per chip.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/content.py discover(): loads all programs + up to 2000 videos into memory and filters in Python on every request — acceptable at 72 items but will not scale; move filters into the Mongo query when the library grows.
discover_facets() returns the static FOCUS_AREAS/INTENSITIES lists rather than values actually present in data, which is why the Energy chip surfaces with zero results.
Program tag fields (focus_areas/intensity/language) are not constrained by Pydantic Literal/enum in the admin update path.
seed_data_creation: None. Temporarily edited Core 26+ program tags via admin UI/API for the persistence test and restored them to seed values (focus_areas=[Beginner basics, Flexibility], intensity=gentle, language=both).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Discover API + page + homepage strips + admin tag editor all functionally working. Only open items are data-quality (Energy focus never assigned, all content language='both') and missing enum validation on admin program PATCH. Admin program update route is PATCH /api/admin/programs/{id} (PUT returns 405). Discover totals at test time: 72 items = 3 programs + 69 classes; focus=Back care -> 6; type=class&duration=5-15 -> 6. Do NOT register users or submit checkout/free-class forms (SMTP + payments live).
rca_of_the_issue: seed.py _focus(title, level) derives focus tags from title/level keywords only; no branch emits 'Energy', and language is hardcoded to 'both' for every doc — so two of the eight focus chips and the whole Language facet are non-functional in the UI even though the API filter logic itself is correct (verified: unknown focus returns [] with 200, buckets are disjoint and cover all 69 classes).
